mechanism: Read-only web opens of primary vendor pages and official GitHub advisory/release pages

sources.observation: Microsoft lists 7.6.6 as the current LTS update and 2028-11-14 as the 7.6 support end date; only current serviced updates on supported host operating systems receive support. Windows PowerShell follows its Windows host lifecycle.
The official September 11 advisory identifies 7.6.6 as patched for CVE-2026-62801. This specific fix does not establish freedom from all vulnerabilities.

The official page identifies Ghostscript/GhostPDL 10.08.0, released September 8, and marks it Latest at this observation. The project retains the separately tested pin rather than treating a version string as executable authentication.
The vendor table lists CVE-2026-19547 and CVE-2026-39919 as fixed in 10.08.0; no comprehensive security assurance is inferred.
The vendor supplies a Windows 10/11 installer and pdftk-2.02-src.zip. Vendor download availability does not establish project validation on Windows 10 or absence of security defects.

The vendor describes GPL version 2 and separate redistribution terms. The application package excludes vendor executables and directs users to applicable vendor terms; this review is attribution and routing, not a legal exemption determination.
Ghostscript's vendor download page describes open source AGPL and commercial licensing alternatives.

Artifex describes AGPLv3 and commercial licenses, with compliance obligations. This supports the frozen dependency attribution without implying that separate installation removes every licensing obligation.

limitations: These are dated online vendor observations, not new native execution, authenticity proof, future support assurances or guarantees of security.
Exact R public docs retain their original 2026-10-09 observation dates; no runtime or packaged source file was edited.
